tests.description: Supporting live API evidence: a fresh same-account session reads a changed, isolated event; client session ownership remains browser/store scope.

requirements: Generate UUID id and short unique label (at most 90 characters so the Updated prefix remains under the 100-character limit)
Populate every events.Row field: id, user_id, label, event_date, created_at, description, icon
Use anchored local calendar date, valid icon default calendar, description null
Pure data only; perform no server writes or cleanup
No new merged fixture entry needed

playwright_utils_deviations.reason: Reauthentication is the behavior under test; initial setup uses the existing authToken provider fixture. The token endpoint still uses mandated apiRequest.

provider_scrutiny: not-applicable: live API integration; no Pact artifacts
pact_fallback_source: Existing project schema and pinned Supabase auth-js source; no broker calls or retry probe

confidence.rationale: Existing fixtures and worker identity helpers, generated events.Row, and pinned auth-js request/JWT definitions establish every used interface.
unknowns: Spec not executed in this generation worker
No auth/events response validation schema exists; only fields under test are asserted
Client stale load ownership cannot be observed by direct API requests

summary: Generated one P1 supporting API regression with checked identity, distinct session lifetime, changed server data, exact-ID cleanup and local-only session logout. No E2E, fixture implementation, Pact artifacts, or test execution performed. No claim of immediate old access-token revocation. Failure ownership permutations remain covered by the existing store/component suites and the separately generated browser tests.

core_knowledge_summary.levels: Select the lowest useful level; this API test proves server/auth integration, not client ownership. Avoid repeating unchanged RLS/read-window/write permutations.
core_knowledge_summary.priorities: P0 for auth/data-isolation regressions, P1 for supporting live integration and core browser journeys. Priority follows impact rather than an invented risk score.
core_knowledge_summary.data: Use explicit factory overrides, unique IDs, API setup, worker isolation, and checked generated-ID cleanup. No broad reset.
core_knowledge_summary.quality: Deterministic synchronization; explicit falsifiable assertions; no hard waits, silent errors, focus or bare skips; focused tests under 90 seconds.
core_knowledge_summary.evidence: Report generated/collected/executed separately, reconcile counts, and label missing measurements rather than passing them. A successor-load-only race already passes the old latestLoadId guard.
core_knowledge_summary.confidence: State evidence and unknowns before nontrivial generation. Current interface evidence supports 8/10; runtime results remain pending.
core_knowledge_summary.libraries: Flag plus installed package binds apiRequest, merged fixtures, log and recurse if polling is needed. Document each surviving deviation.
core_knowledge_summary.execution: Run changed P0/P1 first; collect full failure evidence. Recommend five to ten repeat runs for race-sensitive browser tests before merge and report only repeats actually executed.
